hist-med-01-c1.text: Yale University, Open Yale Courses (Paul Freedman, HIST 210). Lecture 19 - Charlemagne (HIST 210, The Early Middle Ages, 284-1000). Open Yale Courses, Yale University.
hist-med-01-c1.quote: Charlemagne, crowned emperor in Rome by Pope Leo III in 800, made strides in reestablishing the Roman Empire
hist-med-01-c1.claim: In 800 CE, Pope Leo III crowned Charlemagne, King of the Franks, Emperor of the Romans.
